theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas is rank 2, eligible, with the highest durability_bar among leaders (0.61) and 57% breadth — the most internally coherent commodity leadership on the board. The absolute-trend gate (the one validated leg) confirms trend discipline materially helped this market historically (gate_helps=true). With Base Metals tagged mean-revert and the margin between leaders only 0.11, Oil & Gas is the stronger trend-quality candidate within the dual-commodity leadership.
theses.dissent: Mixed hurst_tag and an oil complex that is historically prone to supply-shock reversals; the broad rotation (frac 0.56) means no clean directional handoff, and the leader margin is thin enough that Base Metals could reassert dominance without warning.
